messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> page fired: P1 latency | rule=latency.p99.global | svc=inference-hotpath | pd-incident=PD12345 :rotating_light:

maria (SRE): got the page, looking. observed p99 ~ 2.6s on hotpath, baseline ~1.1s. this started ~5m ago.

kevin (oncall): acked PD12345. i'm on it. @jordan can you confirm if there was any recent rollout?

jordan (model-ops): we merged a batching tweak 12m ago to reduce micro-batches (batch_window_ms from 5->2). rolling out to 20% last deploy. might correlate.

maria (SRE): good call. checkpointing metrics: qps steady, tail latency increased, error rate flat. looks perf regress not errors.

sam (infra): checking node metrics now — some pods on gpu-pool-2 showing higher GPU utilization and queue depth. possible hotkey skew.

jordan (model-ops): i'm going to revert the batch_window change on the canary group. patching now.

kevin (oncall): while jordan reverts, can we temporarily shift traffic off gpupool-2 to gpupool-3? fallback route exists.

sam (infra): running one-off reroute:
```bash
# route 30% of traffic away from gpupool-2
redwood route update inference-hotpath --from gpupool-2 --to gpupool-3 --weight 70
```

ops-bot: command accepted. traffic change submitted (ticket: ROUTE-872).

jordan (model-ops): revert done on canary (2 nodes). tail latency on canary down from 2.5s -> 1.2s. patch will roll back to 100% in the next 30s if stable.

maria (SRE): nice. observing cluster-wide p99 drifting down but still above SLO on a few shards. keeping PD acknowledged for now.

kevin (oncall): customer impact? any active customer complaints?

maria (SRE): no pagerized customer tickets yet. internal synthetic checks show ~10% of requests > 2s for short window, likely affecting interactive apps. flagging CS to monitor. @jordan any degradation in quality?

jordan (model-ops): quality unaffected. just latency. revert removes the micro-batching optimization that increased head-of-line contention.

sam (infra): gpupool-2 pods show one hot instance with heavy KV-cache misses. restarting that pod now:
```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/hotpath-worker -l pool=gpupool-2 -n inference
```

ops-bot: deploybot -> restart initiated on 4 pods.

maria (SRE): progress check: p99 global 1.3s, p95 0.6s. still marginally above SLO of 1.0s for p99 during spike windows.

kevin (oncall): keep PD ack. i'm going to open a short bridge and handoff to morning oncall in 30m if stable. anyone else jump in?

jordan (model-ops): I'll stay for 20m to watch for regression after full rollback.

sam (infra): pods recovering. KV miss rate back to baseline on restarted node.

maria (SRE): adding runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/latency-hotpath (see section "rollback batch-window")

kevin (oncall): quick mitigations checklist applied: revert batch tweak, restart bad pod, traffic reroute. leaving PD acknowledged. prepare notes for postmortem.

maria (SRE): capturing timeline for postmortem:
- 1719994200 deploy: batch_window change rolled to 20%
- 1719994300 p99 spike detected, incident-bot paged PD12345
- 1719994322 PD ack by kevin, initial triage
- 1719994340 revert on canary -> improvement
- 1719994355 cluster reroute and pod restart -> p99 trending down

kevin (oncall): tagging CS: @help -> please watch for user reports and amplify if any spikes.

ops-bot: PD status update -> PD12345 status: acknowledged,escalation paused.

maria (SRE): next action items:
- jordan to follow up with a safe batching configuration (experiment plan)
- infra to add KV cache warmup/eviction metrics to alerting
- oncall to draft incident blameless summary and link in Jira (INC-5678)

jordan (model-ops): will open a short-lived experiment with gradual step increases and synthetic load test before re-enabling.

sam (infra): I'll add a transient alert to detect single-pod KV miss spikes and auto-drain for 5m.

kevin (oncall): i'll hand off in 25m to morning rotation if no regressions. for now, keeping PD acknowledged. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD12345 -> note: incident will auto-resolve when metrics stable for 10m.

maria (SRE): final check at 1719994365: p99 = 0.98s, p95 = 0.56s. SLO met. closing incident in retrospective.

kevin (oncall): closing here. fill out INC-5678 with timeline and action items. good job team. :tada:
